summary: Verified BIDDING minimum-bid (£50) enforcement and DECLINE (hide-for-driver-only) for both fixed-price and bidding jobs, plus Driver Hub UI states for fixed vs bidding job detail. 4/4 backend tests pass; 12/12 Playwright UI assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py driver_bid correctly rejects price < MIN_BID (50) with HTTP 400 and a clear message that includes '£50'.
driver_decline uses $addToSet on booking.declined_by; driver_available_jobs filters on user_id in declined_by for both bidding and fixed lists — correct scoping (other drivers still see the job).

DriverJobDetail.jsx: fixed-price branch renders three actions (Accept/Cancel(decline)/Message) and no price input; bidding branch enforces MIN_BID=50 client-side with red warning + disabled submit. UI matches backend rule.

Minor: /driver/jobs/{id}/decline does not validate that the booking exists or that mode is 'fixed' — currently a driver can silently mark any booking id as declined. Consider a 404 if booking not found and, optionally, restrict to mode fixed/bidding & status quoting. Not blocking.
test_credentials: Admin anisha91ahmed@gmail.com / MoveAdmin#2026. Test driver + customer created dynamically per run.
seed_data_creation: backend/tests/seed_ui_bid_decline.py creates: a fresh approved driver, a customer, one bidding booking (broadcast) and one fixed-price booking (mode+price patched directly in Mongo to simulate the driver-cancel re-offer state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: (1) source /app/backend/.env and /app/frontend/.env; (2) run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bid_min_and_decline.py -v`; (3) for UI, first run `python /app/backend/tests/seed_ui_bid_decline.py` to obtain driver email + booking ids, then drive the Playwright flow against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/login. data-testids verified: open-{booking_id}, driver-job-detail, fixed-price-badge, job-detail-accept, job-detail-decline, job-detail-message, job-detail-quote-input, min-bid-warning, job-detail-submit-quote, job-detail-back.
